action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 25 https://api.capbypass.pro/ -o /tmp/cb.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; grep -oiE '(ReCaptcha|HCaptcha|Turnstile|Cloudflare|ImageToText)[A-Za-z0-9]*' /tmp/cb.html | sort -u | head -20; echo "=== docs ==="; for u in /docs /openapi.json /api; do printf "%-14s " $u; curl -s --max-time 20 "https://api.capbypass.pro$u" -o /tmp/x.json -w "%{http_code} "; head -c 100 /tmp/x.json; echo; done
